verdict.rationale: Vercel documents Vercel Agent as an AI assistant built into the product, available via dashboard chat and Slack. Users can hand it tasks: investigating production issues, reviewing code, reproducing issues in sandboxes, and taking approved actions. The capability is first-party but in public beta and limited to Pro and Enterprise teams. Missing for 10: general availability beyond the Pro/Enterprise beta, a detailed inventory of which actions can be delegated, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Vercel Agent is an AI assistant built into Vercel. Use it to understand your projects, investigate production issues, review code, and take approved actions.
It can use secure sandboxes to reproduce issues, validate generated code, and run checks before suggested changes reach production.
Chat in Slack, dashboard chat, Investigations, and Code Review are in public beta for Pro and Enterprise teams.
